name: Kitaaiki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitaaiki village emblem in orange: a stylised five-pointed star-like device with a peaked top.
history: Municipal flag of Kitaaiki, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kitaaiki village emblem — a stylised five-pointed star-like device with a peaked top
